newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills rating up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills rating up.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Friday she raised her rating on General Mills Inc to outperform from market performer late Thursday.
-- She also raised her earnings estimates for the cereal and food company by $0.05 a share to $3.15 for fiscal 1997 and to $3.50 for fiscal 1998.

-- This followed stronger than expected earnings for the second quarter ended in November of $1.00 a share, up from $0.92 a year ago. The earnings, which were reported on Thursday, were also above the First Call consensus of analysts' estimates of $0.95 a share.
